title: Minimising x² with x ≥ 1
caption: The free minimum x = 0 breaks x ≥ 1, so the constraint is active and x* = 1 with value 1. The gradient of f there is 2, equal to the multiplier μ = 2 ≥ 0.
alt: The parabola y = x² with the feasible part x ≥ 1 highlighted, the optimum at (1, 1) and the infeasible vertex at the origin.
description: The unconstrained minimum is x = 0, which has x < 1.
Case μ = 0 therefore fails: the constraint must be active, so x = 1.
Stationarity 2x − μ = 0 gives μ = 2 at x = 1.
μ = 2 ≥ 0, so x* = 1 satisfies the KKT conditions with value 1.

checks.name: on x ≥ 1 the minimum is at x = 1 with value 1
